candidate.answerReason: The distinct, coplanar lines a and c are perpendicular to the same line b, so they are parallel. Distinctness excludes coincidence.

methods.label: Use the common perpendicular
methods.explanation: Both \(a\) and \(c\) are perpendicular to \(b\). In the same plane, two lines perpendicular to the same line are parallel to each other, so \(a\parallel c\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 7 parallelism criterion for two coplanar lines perpendicular to one line.
